payload.description_html: Lithology and ranges of key cynodont taxa from the Burgersdorp Formation and underlying Katberg Formation. This is a generalized interpretation based on the area around Sterkstroom and modified from the work of Hancox (1998), then updated based on information in Hancox, Neveling & Rubidge (2020). The palaeosol marking the boundary between the upper Katberg and lower Burgersdorp formations is only found across some of the outcrop. Taxa are shown approximately to scale in relation to each other. Silhouettes modified from life reconstructions by Mojca Janezic, Nobu Tamura, and Gabriel Ugueto.
